probes.label: leaf
probes.why: An owner-backed onSettled is a leaf; construct in the component owner in the correct twin.

probes.label: initial-start
probes.why: Initial accessor runs in the owner-backed onSettled leaf. Only misuse calls onCleanup there; correct returns the element directly.

probes.label: native-two
probes.why: After exact overload selection, native MutationObserver dispatch has no ambient owner. Correct restores the captured component owner before onCleanup.
